initiatives.title: A prototype that shows the whole mission
initiatives.why: Every kind of participant and every kind of help, on a phone, in the approved voice. The thing to hand someone so they get it in a minute.

initiatives.title: A backend that can run it for real
initiatives.why: Real data, real accounts, real matching. The prototype's flows, made durable.

initiatives.title: Trust
initiatives.why: Everyone here is who they say they are. Grants only reach confirmed organizations. No spam, no fraud.

initiatives.title: The public site
initiatives.why: Where the idea-giver and early partners see progress: prototype, design brief, how it works, this roadmap.

initiatives.title: The organization behind it
initiatives.why: Decisions that aren't code: the name, the entity, the platform, the partners.

initiatives.title: A working alpha for invited nonprofits
initiatives.why: Real organizations post real needs and offers, start threads, and make golden threads, on the map, on any phone or desktop. Target: live Sep 30.
